answer: Just as a ceramic matrix composite vine grows a graded SiC summit to dissipate a re-entry comet's aerothermal flux, an agent economy can bind each identity to a bonded stake whose history is chained into a shared ablation ledger. Colluders must replicate that full thermal history to counterfeit a sybil, so verification cost scales with stake depth rather than nominal. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
